text: Loop-closure consistency: A → B → A must look the same
description: Unsupervised spatial consistency (object permanence) along random camera loops, including translation loops.

status.comment: Analysis 2026-11-23 (before implementing): an A->B->A loss is only learnable for content that stays in the state while the camera is at B. In training (train.py, 32 px crop) everything that leaves the crop is lost, so a loop loss would only penalise the net for not knowing what it cannot know. The runtime already keeps a margin (main.rs OVERSCAN widens the fov). Prerequisite step: train with a state margin (crop + margin px each side, loss and eval only on the inner crop, turn augmentation crossing the inner border), matching OVERSCAN; then add the loop: after the K real steps, replay the camera back to step 1 (dt = 0, no truth) and L1 the result against the step-1 prediction where both are covered. Relates to ac841219 (the low-res layer wider than the view is the same margin).
